newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Peru asks to join Mercosur - Argentine official.
newsitem.headline: Peru asks to join Mercosur - Argentine official.

text.p: Peru officially asked to join South America's Mercosur customs union Thursday, said Argentine Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni.
"Next week we will start in Montevideo, together with Peruvian officials, the technical study for negotiating a free trade agreement," Guadagni told reporters.
He said Peru was seeking an associate agreement with the four-nation trade bloc, similar to ones already signed by Bolivia and Chile.
"We trust that the negotiations will be as rapid as possible," he said.

Mercosur groups Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay. In addition to their associate deals with Bolivia and Chile, Mercosur countries have signed an agreement to start talks with the European Union and are discussing ties with various other countries, including Canada.
Guadagni was in Belo Horizonte for a meeting of officials from the Free Trade Area of Americas (FTAA).
